title: anodontea xanthocarpa
intro: Anodontea xanthocarpa, commonly known as the yellow fruit anodontea or yellow fruit anodontea shrub, is a plant species in the Malvaceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include treating fever, cough, and respiratory issues due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Anodontea xanthocarpa include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight off infections, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
